input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for chapter13 clienta application, service b client, chapter13 clientb application. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include data analytics functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with test functionality, so that I can accomplish my test-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with bus event functionality, so that I can accomplish my bus event-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with service a functionality, so that I can accomplish my service a-related tasks.
